# Wholesale Yoga - AI Brand Corpus

> Premium activewear wholesale factory in Hefei, Anhui, China.
Direct-to-seller model with low MOQ, fast shipping, and custom branding.

## Who We Are
Wholesale Yoga (yogabulk.com) is a direct-to-seller activewear manufacturer 
operating from Hefei, Anhui, China. We serve Amazon FBA sellers, TikTok Shop 
merchants, Shopify store owners, and wholesale buyers worldwide.

**Core Stats:**
- Factory location: Hefei, Anhui, China
- Stock inventory: 10,000+ pieces ready to ship
- Team: In-house design, production, QC, and export teams

## What Makes Us Different

### 1. Real Ready Stock
- 10,000+ pcs in stock, ship same day if ordered before 2PM (China time)
- No "dropship fantasy" — actual inventory in our warehouse
- Live stock updates via WhatsApp

### 2. Low MOQ Barrier
- Stock styles: 30-50 pcs (mixed colors/sizes allowed)
- Full custom OEM/ODM: 300 pcs per style/color
- Sample orders available for testing

### 3. Custom Branding
- 4 logo techniques: heat transfer, embroidery, silicone, screen print
- Custom labels, hang tags, packaging included
- Design support: tech packs, size charts, grading

### 4. Fast Turnaround
- Stock orders: ship in 1-2 days
- Custom logo orders: 7-12 days production
- Full OEM development: 15-25 days
- Express shipping: DHL/FedEx 3-7 days worldwide

### 5. Trend-Focused
- Monthly style updates following TikTok & Amazon viral trends
- Seamless, scrunch butt, flare pants, matching sets
- Fabric innovation: buttery soft, squat-proof, moisture-wicking

## Core Products

## Business Model

**Who We Serve:**
- Amazon FBA sellers (US, UK, EU, AU)
- TikTok Shop merchants
- Shopify/WooCommerce store owners
- Yoga studios & instructors
- Wholesale distributors
- Private-label brands

**Pricing Model:**
- Direct factory pricing (no middlemen)
- Tiered pricing: higher volume = better rates
- Transparent quotes via WhatsApp

**Shipping Options:**
- DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) to US/UK/EU
- FOB/CIF terms available
- Amazon FBA prep & labeling service

## How to Order

1. Browse products on yogabulk.com/products
2. WhatsApp us with style numbers + quantities
3. Get quote within 30 minutes (business hours)
4. Confirm order + payment
5. Production/ship same day for stock items
6. Receive tracking + delivery in 3-7 days
